string.text:
Crafting is a very broad subject. It includes dismantling weapons and suits, creating items, and making special components.
 Dismantling is done by dragging the required tool or tool set (for suits) directly onto the suit in your inventory.


%c[0,215,215,215]• %c[ui_gray_2]Weapon dismantling %c[0,215,215,215]•%c[ui_gray_2].
 Weapon dismantling is done with special tools: a sledgehammer, a crowbar, and a Swiss Army knife. Each tool can be used to dismantle specific weapons.
 A crowbar can dismantle 7.62 rifles, 9 mm rifles, 5.56 rifles, 5.45 rifles, submachine guns, sawed-off guns, and shotguns. It cannot dismantle any pistols.
 A sledgehammer can dismantle 7.62 rifles, 9 mm rifles, 5.56 rifles, 5.45 rifles, submachine guns, sawed-off guns, shotguns, and pistols.
 A Swiss Army knife can dismantle only pistols, whether worn or rusty.

%c[0,215,215,215]• %c[ui_gray_2]Suit dismantling %c[0,215,215,215]•%c[ui_gray_2].
 Suits can be dismantled with rough, regular, or fine tool sets, or with a Swiss Army knife.
 A Swiss Army knife can cut only items made entirely of fabric: berets, hats, bandages, balaclavas, and similar items.
 Rough tools can also cut the same items as a Swiss Army knife. They are intended for dismantling low-tech items such as various jackets, coats, and some gas masks.
 Regular tools can dismantle the same items as rough tools. They are intended for medium-tech items: handmade stalker suits, stalker suits with armor plates such as SEVA (Duty suits, heavy coats, and the scientists' Iolite), and Amber-type suits.
 Fine tools can also cut the same items as regular tools. They are intended for high-tech items: all kinds of SEVA suits, Ecologist suits, heavy armored suits (Bulat and Skat), exoskeletons, heavy Sunrise armored suits, and high-tech helmets (Sphere helmets and tactical helmets). They cannot dismantle the Barrier helmet, just like any other tools.

%c[0,215,215,215]• %c[ui_gray_2]Creating items %c[0,215,215,215]•%c[ui_gray_2].
 Creating items is perhaps the broadest subject of all. Tinkerers are constantly coming up with new ways to make things, and traders bring all kinds of new items into the Zone that can be used to craft something.
 

 One of the most important and widely used techniques in the Zone is decontaminating items that can be decontaminated. Decontamination liquid can be made by mixing Aquatabs with any vodka.
 Mix Aquatabs and vodka by dragging one onto the other in your inventory. To decontaminate an item, drag either the item onto the liquid or the liquid onto the item in your inventory.
 

 Tinkerers also make essential items from whatever is at hand. For example, bandages can be made from rags and vodka by dragging one onto the other.
 Rags can be obtained by cutting fabric items (bandages, hats, balaclavas, bandanas, and so on) with a Swiss Army knife. All these actions are done by dragging one item onto another in your inventory.
 You can also get pieces of fabric by dismantling suits or simply find them. Traders sell some types of fabric.
 

 You can also sew yourself a backpack or a sleeping bag. To do so, buy a sewing kit and the required materials from a trader, then drag one onto the other in your inventory.
 

 Traders also sell materials for making hand-rolled cigarettes. The resulting roll-ups are much more effective than cigarettes.
 Traders sometimes also stock ammunition-crafting kits, usually for buckshot. Homemade buckshot is slightly less effective, but much cheaper than factory-made buckshot.

%c[0,215,215,215]• %c[ui_gray_2]Replacing components %c[0,215,215,215]•%c[ui_gray_2].
 Replacing components is also a popular way to repair various items.
 The most common replacement is a weapon barrel. You need a barrel in good condition, and its caliber must match the weapon's caliber.
 If a barrel is worn, it can be cleaned with kerosene, gasoline, vodka, weapon-cleaning products, cleaning kits, gun oil, or repair kits.
 If a barrel is rusty, it can be restored to normal condition with weapon-cleaning products, cleaning kits, gun oil, or repair kits.
 Next, you will need a kit of the appropriate caliber to replace the barrel with one of the same caliber. Using the kit and a barrel, you can restore up to 50% of a weapon's durability, regardless of its initial condition.
 

 You can also replace the servos in exoskeletons. You need a servo, which can be obtained by dismantling an exoskeleton, and a servo-replacement kit.
 Using the kit and a servo, you can restore up to 30% of an exoskeleton's durability, regardless of its initial condition.
